title: Boss: the office LAN
summary: Run the switching, VLAN and addressing logic of a small office network.

steps.title: The office
body: One switch stack, a few VLANs, one DHCP pool. Times are in seconds.

steps.title: Switch with ageing
prompt: Write a class `AgingSwitch(int ports, int maxAge)` with `List<int> Receive(int port, string src, string dst, int now)`.
It behaves like the learning switch (ports 1..n, ascending, broadcast and unknown destinations flood, same port filters),
except that an entry learned at time `t` is forgotten once `now - t >= maxAge`. Learning refreshes the time. MACs are case-insensitive.
solution: private readonly Dictionary<string, (int Port, int Seen)> table = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
public AgingSwitch(int ports, int maxAge) { this.ports = ports; this.maxAge = maxAge; }
public List<int> Receive(int port, string src, string dst, int now)
if (now - e.Seen < maxAge) return e.Port == port ? new List<int>() : new List<int> { e.Port };
template: Dojo.Eq("flood first", new List<int> { 2, 3 }, dojoS.Receive(1, dojoA, dojoB, 0));
Dojo.Eq("learned", new List<int> { 1 }, dojoS.Receive(2, dojoB, dojoA, 10));
Dojo.Eq("B still fresh (learned at 10, now 309)", new List<int> { 2 }, dojoS.Receive(3, "cc:00:00:00:00:03", dojoB, 309));
Dojo.Eq("A aged out (learned at 0, now 310)", new List<int> { 1, 3 }, dojoS.Receive(2, dojoB, dojoA, 310));
hints: An expired entry behaves like an unknown one: remove it and flood.

steps.title: Can they talk directly?
prompt: Hosts are described by `(string Cidr, int Vlan)`, where `Cidr` is the host's own address with prefix (e.g. `"10.0.10.5/24"`).
Write `string Path(Dictionary<string, (string Cidr, int Vlan)> hosts, string a, string b)` returning:
1. `"via router (different VLAN)"` if their VLANs differ;
2. `"mask mismatch"` if A thinks B is local but B doesn't think A is local (or the other way round);
3. `"via router (different subnet)"` if neither thinks the other is local;

uint MaskOf(int prefix) => prefix == 0 ? 0u : uint.MaxValue << (32 - prefix);

steps.title: Leases that expire
prompt: Write a class `LeasePool(string first, string last, int leaseSeconds)` with:
- `string? Request(string mac, int now)`: if the MAC holds an unexpired lease, renew it (new expiry `now + leaseSeconds`) and return its address;
otherwise assign the lowest address not held by an **unexpired** lease (expired leases are free again). `null` if none.
- `string? Owner(string ip, int now)`: the MAC holding an unexpired lease on `ip`, or `null`.
A lease is unexpired while `now < expiry`. MACs are case-insensitive.
starter: public LeasePool(string first, string last, int leaseSeconds)
solution: private readonly Dictionary<string, (uint Ip, int Expires)> leases = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
public LeasePool(string first, string last, int leaseSeconds) { this.first = ToU(first); this.last = ToU(last); this.leaseSeconds = leaseSeconds; }
static uint ToU(string ip) => ip.Split('.').Aggregate(0u, (acc, o) => (acc << 8) | uint.Parse(o));
public string? Request(string mac, int now)
if (leases.TryGetValue(mac, out var l) && now < l.Expires)
var held = new HashSet<uint>(leases.Where(kv => now < kv.Value.Expires).Select(kv => kv.Value.Ip));
for (uint a = first; a <= last; a++)
if (!held.Contains(a)) { leases[mac] = (a, now + leaseSeconds); return FromU(a); }
public string? Owner(string ip, int now)
=> leases.Where(kv => now < kv.Value.Expires && FromU(kv.Value.Ip) == ip).Select(kv => kv.Key).FirstOrDefault();
template: Dojo.Eq("second lease expired at 110", null, dojoP.Owner("10.0.0.11", 110));
Dojo.Eq("renewed lease still held at 150", "aa:00:00:00:00:01", dojoP.Owner("10.0.0.10", 150));
hints: Free addresses are those not held by a lease with `now < Expires`.
